modelRouting.notes: Catalog key gpt-6.1-sol exists in the 1405-model snapshot (vision+pdf flags only). Presence is not access: no credential, price, context window, or live call was verified, so packets may name the model but no lane may invoke it.

references.architecture: AG-UI agent endpoint per coworker; every tool call passes one gateway that decides, records, then acts; each coworker owns a container with its own browser profile and files
references.adoptedPattern: one decide-and-record gateway plus a per-worker computer boundary and human takeover

references.architecture: planner/executor loop with modular tools over an LLM config; Browser Use starts as a default MCP server with browser_exec and browser_screenshot
references.adoptedPattern: planner/executor split where only the executor holds the action lease
notAdopted: Python runtime and provider keys in repo

references.architecture: persistent specialist Dots with their own durable computer, per-Dot MCP tool permissions, and a human-in-the-loop approve card before any non-read-only tool runs
references.adoptedPattern: per-role tool ceiling with an explicit approval card before any effect

lanes.notes: Headless JSON run only; auto-approve is forced false and plan mode is the default.
Manus API v2 task.create: asynchronous task, polled with task.listMessages, private share visibility only.
Cue is a Manus 2.0 app with per-agent email, phone, wallet, and computer; no public Cue API is documented, so it stays a human-run lane.

stopRules: no clone, install, or package resolution against a reference repository
no provider or paid call without a PROVIDER_CALL ticket and open gate
one maker lease per path; checker never edits maker-owned files
cue stays human-operated until a public API and payment authority are admitted
packets never carry secret values, cookies, or ambient authority
no queue, A2A, Telegram, Cloudflare, or deploy effect from a spawn plan
